description: Na₂Ba₂U(S₂O)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.30 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.43 Å. Ba is bonded to five S and two equivalent O atoms to form distorted BaS₅O₂ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one US₄O₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent BaS₅O₂ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent US₄O₂ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent BaS₅O₂ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 17°. There are a spread of Ba-S bond distances ranging from 3.20-3.25 Å. There is one shorter (2.81 Å) and one longer (2.82 Å) Ba-O bond length. U is bonded to four S and two equivalent O atoms to form distorted US₄O₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent BaS₅O₂ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with six equivalent BaS₅O₂ pentagonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.67 Å) and two longer (2.68 Å) U-S bond lengths. Both U-O bond lengths are 1.92 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na, three equivalent Ba, and one U atom to form SBa₃Na₂U octahedra that share corners with five SBa₃Na₂U octahedra, corners with four equivalent OBa₂NaU tetrahedra, edges with nine SBa₃Na₂U octahedra, and edges with three equivalent OBa₂NaU tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. In the second S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one U atom to form distorted SBa₂Na₃U octahedra that share corners with five SBa₃Na₂U octahedra, corners with five equivalent OBa₂NaU tetrahedra, edges with nine SBa₃Na₂U octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OBa₂NaU tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one U atom to form distorted OBa₂NaU tetrahedra that share corners with nine SBa₃Na₂U octahedra,  a cornercorner with one OBa₂NaU tetrahedra, edges with five SBa₃Na₂U octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OBa₂NaU tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-90°.
